Results.ReviewText: I am very happy and satisfied with the Spirit II grill. Assembly was easy with well thought out and clear instructions. The product is durable and user-friendly. The Weber Grills app is exceptionally helpful for learning how to use the grill to cook a variety of food choices. I have quickly evolved from someone who could not grill a hotdog without burning it to a master of grilling swordfish, chicken, hamburgers, carne asada, etc. without burning or sticking! Thank you Weber!
Results.Title: I love the Spirit II Grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This grill replaced my 35 year old Weber. The old grill was finally just too worn out to repair. This new grill works great! Lights easy, gets hot fast. The heat seems to be very even and the grill is large enough for our family of 5 but others cooking for larger groups may be better off with a larger model. I took my time when I put the grill together and it took a little over 3 hours from opening the box and sorting through the parts to hooking it up and lighting it. Over all it came well packaged, no dents or scratches. One frame part had a slight bend in a corner it but it was easy to bend it back into shape.
Results.Title: Bought a new Weber

Results.ReviewText: Best small grill!  This grill evenly heats well with minimal cold spots.  It will also hold a lot, in spite of it's smaller surface area...a family bbq with 20 guests is no problem. Very sturdy construction.  We grill year-round even though we are in Oregon, about 3 times a week. Three years later it is holding up well. I do however give it a good cleaning every 3-4 mos. due to its high usage. Usually by now we have to purchase a new grill, but not this time. I opted to replace a few parts that were wearing out and customer service was excellent! The spot on the side to "hang" and monitor the propane tank is surprisingly accurate.  When the indicator says the tank is 1/4 full, it generally is. In 7 years when the warranty is up we will be purchasing another one of these.
Results.Title: Best small grill

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
